title: PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 8 - View A
doubts: Annotation text on this file is drawn as vector paths (no text layer except the notes); boxes were set from the blue annotation pixels inside hand-placed regions and checked on overlays. Boxes are axis-aligned around rotated annotations and overlap.
Ⓕ (free state) and Ⓜ modifiers written in the cell as printed, e.g. ⌖|⌀.023ⓂⒻ|A|B|C.
T1 (⏥|.03Ⓕ) and T2 (⏥|.015) are two stacked single frames on datum feature A; T14 and T15 likewise stacked on one leader.
Hole sizes D1, D2, D9 keyed as hole_callout; T13 takes multiplier 2 from D9 '2X'.

Note 4 (frame T28 inline) keyed with official_id 'note 4'. Note 5 (restraint for inspection, part of STR6) kept as one note item with official_id 'note 5', since it sets how every restrained requirement is inspected.
Excluded: notes 1 (CAD model required), 2 (precedence), 3 (applicable standards), 6 (UNITS: INCHES); datum feature symbols DF1 A, DF2 B, DF3 C; coordinate systems CS1, CS2.

items.text: 5. DIMENSIONING AND TOLERANCING APPLY WITH PART RESTRAINED AS FOLLOWS, EXCEPT AS INDICATED. PLACE DATUM FEATURE A AGAINST DATUM FEATURE SIMULATOR A. ENGAGE DATUM FEATURES B AND C WITH DATUM FEATURE SIMULATORS B AND C RESPECTIVELY. APPLY LOAD TO PART TO RESTRAIN DATUM FEATURE A AGAINST ITS SIMULATOR. DETAILED INSPECTION PLAN NEEDED TO COMPLETELY DEFINE RESTRAINT.
